import numpy as np
from tslearn.early_classification import NonMyopicEarlyClassifier

# Use a small, deterministic dummy dataset to avoid dropped classes and slow fitting
dataset = np.array([
    [[1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [6]],
    [[1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [6]],
    [[1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [6]],
    [[1], [2], [3], [3], [2], [1]],
    [[1], [2], [3], [3], [2], [1]],
    [[1], [2], [3], [3], [2], [1]],
    [[3], [2], [1], [1], [2], [3]],
    [[3], [2], [1], [1], [2], [3]]
], dtype=float)
y_dummy = np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0])

model = NonMyopicEarlyClassifier(
    n_clusters=3, 
    lamb=1000.0, 
    cost_time_parameter=0.1, 
    random_state=0
)
model.fit(dataset, y_dummy)

# Create the generator for 1 time series
gen = model.get_early_predict_proba_generator(n_ts=1)

# Simulate incoming data stream: 3 time steps, 1 time series, 1 feature
incoming_timestamps = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]).reshape(3, 1, 1, 1)

probas_list = []
delays_list = []

for x in incoming_timestamps:
    # x has shape (1, 1, 1) -> (n_ts, n_timestamps, n_features)
    probas, delays = gen.send(x)
    probas_list.append(probas)
    delays_list.append(delays)

assert len(probas_list) == 3, f"Expected 3 probability arrays, got {len(probas_list)}"
assert probas_list[-1].shape == (1, 2), f"Expected probas shape (1, 2), got {probas_list[-1].shape}"
assert delays_list[-1].shape == (1,), f"Expected delays shape (1,), got {delays_list[-1].shape}"

print(f"__CHECK__ get_early_predict_proba_generator probas_shape={probas_list[-1].shape} delays_shape={delays_list[-1].shape}")
